title: LoadMonitorReport
description: The Load Monitor agent's structured proposal (its final JSON response after calling get_resource_snapshot). Validated by steps/load_monitor_step.py's _flags_match against the tool's authoritative flags — a mismatch does not fail the step (deterministic_report stays authoritative either way) but is logged via flag_mismatch for review.

flags.description: Must exactly reproduce (same scope/id/severity set, order-independent) the tool output's flags array.

narrative_summary.description: 2-4 sentence plain-language summary. Must mention injected synthetic variance if any jittered column was used, per the load_monitor.md prompt.
